judges.verdict: All 23 builds pass ./check.sh and meet the spec when used from one thread. What separates them is whether the read-check-write in refund() is atomic. A, B, C, E, F, G, M, N, O, P, R, S, T and U lock it and held the cap and idempotency under 8-thread races. D, H, I, J, K, L, Q, V and W have no lock. Without any code patching, my race probe over-refunded orders and recorded duplicate refunds for one key in all nine of them, and I, K, L/V and W also raised raw exceptions. Among the locked builds, the smaller gaps are how they handle a low-precision caller Decimal context (C, F, N, S reject a valid amount; R leaves the order half-changed) and how much over-defensive code they carry.
